_comment: All in-game dialogue. Each entry: id, speaker, hindi text, optional 'voice' (a key in audio_map.json that resolves to an mp3), 'portrait' (sprite slot), and 'trigger' (intro|level_start|enemy|boss|ending|generic). Add lines freely — nothing here is hard-coded in engine code; levels/enemies reference lines by id.

lines.speaker: Shefali
lines.text: Yeh duniya ko saaf rakhna meri zimmedari hai.

lines.speaker: Shefali
lines.text: Main logon ko maarungi nahi — meditation aur aura se theek karungi.

lines.speaker: Shefali
lines.text: Chaliye, Tea Post se shuruaat karte hain. Prakriti ki rakshak — Shefali!

lines.speaker: Shefali
lines.text: Yahan kitna kachra hai! Sab theek kar deti hoon.

lines.speaker: Litterer
lines.text: Main saara environment kharab kar doonga!

lines.speaker: Litterer
lines.text: Main plant ko jeene nahi doonga!

lines.speaker: Litterer
lines.text: Aapne meri aankhein khol di... ab main bhi prakriti ki raksha karunga!

lines.speaker: Vaishnav
lines.text: Shefali kahan hai? Shefali kahan hai?
